name: unified-build-standard
description: Apply the Unified Build Standard to plan, execute, verify, resume, and complete technical work, run it unattended with away mode, and try version 3: goal-driven building with a plain-English plan.

interface.shortDescription: Plan intelligently, execute economically, verify objectively
interface.longDescription: Applies the Unified Build Standard: right-size the process to the work, plan as one master table with stable step IDs and explicit executor tiers, stop at the phase gate until execution is authorised, verify with the cheapest reliable evidence, and keep durable plan and progress records so any session can resume. Includes away mode: an unattended window (default 8 hours, GMT) with one verified improvement every 30 minutes and a report on return. Also bundles Build Standard v3: start from a measurable goal, choose a Gated or Unattended run, and keep a plain-English plan, a run log and per-step work orders in a build-plan folder.
